configs.r1:
r1

# This file describes the network interfaces
auto lo
iface lo inet loopback
    address 10.0.0.1/32

auto eth1
iface eth1 inet static
    address 192.0.2.1/30

auto eth2
iface eth2 inet static
    address 192.0.2.5/30

auto eth3
iface eth3 inet static
    address 192.0.2.9/30

# ports.conf --

frr version 10.6.1
frr defaults traditional
hostname r1
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
ip forwarding
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.0.0.1/32
!
interface eth1
 ip address 192.0.2.1/30
!
interface eth2
 ip address 192.0.2.5/30
!
interface eth3
 ip address 192.0.2.9/30
!
ip route 10.0.0.2/32 192.0.2.2
ip route 10.0.0.3/32 192.0.2.6
ip route 10.0.0.4/32 192.0.2.10
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.0.0.1
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 update-source lo
 neighbor 10.0.0.2 next-hop-self
 neighbor 10.0.0.3 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.0.3 update-source lo
 neighbor 10.0.0.3 next-hop-self
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 remote-as 65000
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 update-source lo
 neighbor 10.0.0.4 next-hop-self
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 10.0.0.1/32
 exit-address-family
!
line vty
!

change.description: On r3, remove the BGP neighbor 10.0.0.4 (peer r4) to take the session down.
change.patch:
--- r3.conf
+++ r3.conf
@@ -50,9 +50,6 @@
  neighbor 10.0.0.2 remote-as 65000
  neighbor 10.0.0.2 update-source lo
  neighbor 10.0.0.2 next-hop-self
- neighbor 10.0.0.4 remote-as 65000
- neighbor 10.0.0.4 update-source lo
- neighbor 10.0.0.4 next-hop-self
  !
  address-family ipv4 unicast
   network 10.0.0.3/32

presentation.operator_question: Which BGP sessions and prefixes will be lost after this proposed change?
